title: Warriors of Satan 2
summary: Satan and his minions continue their assault.

title: Warriors of Satan
summary: Satan's minions are once again trying to take over the hearts and minds of Nigeria's faithful.

title: Untouched
summary: One last night of pleasure culminates into evidence of infidelity.

title: Ukwa
summary: Ukwa is a village champion who goes to the city to live with his moneyed elder brother. Much to his horror he is relegated to the house driver, in his new abode.

title: Trace
summary: Uyi and Ivory Micheal are a newly-wed couple in a seemingly perfect marriage. After receiving a mysterious package which casts a shadow of doubt over their marriage, past secrets are brought to the surface and they must come to terms with these startling new revelations or risk being torn apart forever.

title: To Be Again
summary: A young widow finds love again but soon discovers her grieving is not over.

title: The Year Between: A Best Friends in the World Movie
summary: After graduation, seven friends promise one last summer together, but when opportunity pulls one of them forward, she has to decide what growing up is worth losing.
synopsis: The Year Between" follows a group of best friends navigating the period after secondary school. Friendships are tested as each person pursues individual goals, leading to unexpected changes and challenges

title: The Xgang
summary: A merciless gang of ex-convicts terrorise the town looting every bank they come across, backed by a powerful godmother who has gone to the land of the dead to acquire protection that renders them invincible. [parts 1-2]

title: The Widow of Nkanu
summary: Muna, the king's betrothed left for dead by her friend, embarks on a quest for revenge.

title: The Stone Drew Ripples
summary: It is a coming-of-age film about a middle-class Nigerian family faced with the harsh dilemma of saving the life of their youngest child with chronic illness. Although they get help from an unlikely stranger, this comes.
synopsis: It is a coming-of-age film about a middle-class Nigerian family faced with the harsh dilemma of saving the life of their youngest child with chronic illness. Although they get help from an unlikely stranger, this comes.

title: Therapy
summary: A young dysfunctional couple tries to patch up their relationship through sessions with a highly unconventional therapist.

title: The Panic Room Encounters
summary: An underground world of prostitution and organised crime is challenged by an agency that on itself is riddled with suspicion and betrayal.

title: The Lost Number
summary: After going renegade on a Foray, Kathleen an English woman goes down south to Ngara Town. Seeking redemption, Kathleen saves Ngara Town and becomes her new hero. But when Diwani (point man of the Foray) comes to Ngara to retrieve from Kathleen what belongs to the Foray, Kathleen must go against the odds to save Ngara from Diwani and a Foray striking for the very soul of Ngara Town.

title: The Life Coach
summary: A renowned life coach, secretly battling mental illness, forms a deep connection with an anonymous online supporter, but as his hidden struggles are exposed, he must navigate the fallout of his past while balancing personal healing, media scrutiny, and new relationships.

title: The Eliminators
summary: The Exterminators is about a couple of businessmen wanting to do anything for power and money. It's a story of greed, lust and violence... Nigerian style!

title: The Campus Queen
summary: Life on a university campus with its own unconventional but dynamic culture ascribes to itself so many unusual privileges which provide unique opportunities for taking liberties mostly in a broad antisocial sense. In the university, several interests groups or clubs are commonplace. Against the Heavy Weights Club, another club Silver Lines Movement is born.  SLM vows to oppose all antisocial, antidemocratic tendencies including economic exploitation on campus. The ensuing battle between the two clubs reveals the frenzied struggles for supremacy in all aspects of campus life.  It also exposes the special interests of godfathers from inside and outside campus.

title: The Best Worst Love Story Ever Told
summary: Two best friends desperate for love run against time to get their men back after an unexpected switch.

title: The Archive:  Queer Nigerians
summary: With Nigerian queer history erased from the national narrative of Nigeria, Queer Nigerians in the UK gather to tell their stories & document their experiences.

title: Strain
summary: When his son is diagnosed with sickle cell disease, a man and his family struggle to face a new reality as they rediscover their shared love.

title: Something To Live For
summary: Bonds deepens, buried secrets threaten to shatter fragile connection between friends
synopsis: Something to Live For centers on Moses, a man reeling from the devastating loss of his wife, Remi. As he struggles to cope with his grief, he unexpectedly forms a deep connection with Aisha, Remi's best friend, who helps him begin to heal. Will his Friendship with Aisha blossom into something beautiful or will his past come calling, shattering his world in the process?

title: Silent Intruder
summary: A married couple grapples with the challenges of a deteriorating sexual relationship. Frustrated by their struggles, they decide to consult a psychologist for assistance. Soon, the psychologist’s motives take a dark turn as manipulation becomes a tool to infiltrate the wife’s life.

title: Sabinus The Best Man
summary: After a riotous bachelor party, a hungover best man and his friends must track down the missing bride before the wedding is ruined.

title: Return of Blackberry Babes (BBB)
summary: The lives of a group of stylish girls on campus revolve around their Blackberry phones. Those that exist on the fringes of the popular group are willing to go to any length to attain one, simply to be accepted. [parts 1-2]

title: Relentless
summary: Relentless tells the story of Obi (Gideon Okeke), a Nigerian peacekeeping soldier who has been deployed to war-torn Sierra Leone. Obi's world is crushed after Blessing, a Sierra Leonean woman whom Obi loves, is mutilated by a gang of child soldiers and he's forced to kill her in order to put her out of pain and misery. He eventually returns to Lagos after the war, and tries to reintegrate himself into his community; in the process, he finds solace in the arms of a prostitute, Honey (Nneka Egbuna) who may help him forget his haunting past and lead him to self-discovery.

title: Queen Latifah
summary: This movie  follows the life of a 30 year old businesswoman who claims to have travelled the world, and belongs to a high society status. Her encounter with a 35 year old businessman reveals all her hidden secrets. Sadly, she is not who she claims, however she is as she was raised in abject poverty and is the only child of an illiterate mother. She lives in a dilapidated building with eccentric neighbours. Her cool manners, fancy clothes and wild claims are a result of her greatest strength: Telling LIES.

title: Purgare
summary: A man who must unearth the truth about himself to ultimately determine his fate
synopsis: A troubled man wakes up trapped in an eerie, unfamiliar purgatory with no memory of how he arrived. To escape this spiritual limbo, he is forced to confront the dark secrets and moral choices of his past life. As mysterious forces judge his worth, every revelation brings him closer to either eternal damnation or absolute redemption. Time runs short as he frantically pieces together the truth of his identity before his final judgment is sealed. Ultimately, his journey becomes a desperate psychological battle to determine the true state of his soul.

title: Prophet Nebu
summary: Two desperate friends who are keen to marry with no willing men on the horizon consult prophet Nebu, a witch doctor who claims to be able to make their dreams come true; however there are stringent conditions to be met.

title: Praise Party
summary: The movie, which highlights the importance of community, seeking professional help, and how taking responsibility, counselling, faith, courage and forgiveness can be therapeutic by bringing healing and restoration to hurting souls.

title: Pot of Life
summary: The king of a great kingdom insists on remaining on the throne, long after it is supposed to be vacated according to tradition.  He believes that his underhand actions have been duly masked, however the past comes spectacularly calling.

title: Passionate Appeal
summary: A story of seduction, lies, greed and death!
synopsis: Tony runs a successful business empire by seducing rich older married but neglected women and blackmailing them for millions of naira. He is so smooth and creative that he always scores big. He is a pro in the art of seduction. Tony lost his wife during an argument over pictures she intercepted of Tony seducing a woman. Tony, Charles, and the gateman put the body in her car and faked an auto accident. Then Tony killed Charles.

title: Pasa Faho
summary: When Azubuike’s 12-year-old son moves in with him, the struggling shoe salesman finds himself balancing fatherhood and the slow collapse of his small shop. As the pair navigate their estrangement, the unspoken becomes a language of its own; one shaped by pride, duty, and the quiet weight of expectation. With the future of both the shop and their relationship hanging in the balance, father and son must find a way to bridge the distance between one another.

title: Osuofia in London 2
summary: Osuofia return to his Nigerian village with a new British wife, the scheming fiancee of his dead brother.

title: Orisa (Deity)
summary: The Rogue King is coming!!

title: Onye Ozi
summary: A naïve Nigerian man excitedly joins his fiancée in the UK after years apart, believing that formidable success awaits him in London. When his expectations are not met, he is thoroughly disappointed.

title: Only in America
summary: A man finds success selling Marijuana from the back of an Ice Cream Truck.

title: One Bite
summary: An innocent girl is kidnapped from school and surprisingly when the kidnapper contacts her parents, it is not money he wants but rather for the father of he girl to confess to a sin he committed in school.

title: Ò Le Kù
summary: It is the story of Ajani, an undergraduate at the University of Ibadan who is in his final year. He is under pressure from his mother to find a partner, and unwittingly finds himself in a love dilemma - dating three women simultaneously; Asake, a secondary school teacher, is his long-term girlfriend. He meets Lola, a fresher who is tall, slim, and pretty. The situation gets complicated when he meets a childhood acquaintance, who eventually takes center stage in the 'drama of love'. Asake's father badgers her to sever her relationship with Ajani but she however falls pregnant and Lola finds out and Ajani has to choose a wife under duress from his mother.

title: Okin
summary: Okin tells the story of a handsome but promiscuous man who became paralyzed after crossing a certain fetish boundary. His wife in turn made life unbearable for him and treated him badly. She ended up narrating how she ignored better suitors to be with her husband.

title: Ojumo Ti Mo
summary: Three years after their father passed, a documentary acts as the perfect stage for a family of four women to talk through their experiences of their loss. Somewhere between distance and time, phone calls provided each person the space to tell their own stories  Ojumo To Mio and its director Simisolaoluwa Akande were the winners of the We Are Parable present Who We Are short film competiton, a contest to highlight the work of 16-19 year-old Black British filmmakers, part of We Are Parable's online takeover of BFI Player.

title: Njem (The Journey)
summary: When life’s endless struggle drives a young hustler to chase migration as his only escape, an unexpected twist ties his dream of freedom to a painful choice that could cost him someone he loves.

title: Neighbours
summary: Christie's admirer soon discovers an unsavoury episode in her past is the reason for the disgust she feels for him.

title: My Story
summary: A civil engineer supervising a building in a poor village takes a liking to a poor boy, who hawks water for his supposedly physically challenged mother. Things take an interesting turn when the engineer takes the boy with him to the city.

title: My Body, God's Temple
summary: Omasilu and Zion are a newlywed couple who must unlearn everything they've been taught about intimacy, desire, and faith when they struggle to consummate their marriage.

title: My Alien Lover
summary: An unexpected encounter and blooming romance between the displaced prince and a Nigerian beauty

title: Mummy Dearest
summary: When a colleague's mother dies, a man who has been avoiding his own intrusive mother travels home for a visit that changes their relationship forever.

title: Mum, Dad, Meet Sam
summary: What happens when the only son of a typical Nigerian family meets the girl of his dreams and she happens to be an English rose? All hell breaks loose.

title: Moth to a Flame
summary: A poor beautiful woman is forced to drive a taxi, in order to pay her father’s ongoing debts at the hospital. However, a strange encounter with an arrogant businessman, changes her current condition for the better, with a proposition too good to pass by.

title: Miss Bamidele's Girls
summary: After constantly disobeying her mother and refusing to play by the rules, Siobhan is sent to a reform school for girls, only to be greeted by a tough disciplinarian.

title: Misfit
summary: A prostitute wakes up to find she has been abducted and struggles to bond with her captors and plot her escape.

title: Love, Sex, Religion
summary: When two high-school sweethearts decide to become devout Christians and avoid having sex, the future they were once certain of is threatened by their ability to remain celibate.
synopsis:
Ace (Tope Tedela) and Chizzy (Zainab Balogun), high school sweethearts whose relationship has always been defined by deep affection and an easy, destined bond. Having grown up together, their future seemed certain until they both undergo a profound spiritual awakening. 
After becoming devout born-again Christians, they decide to commit to celibacy until marriage. This decision radically alters the dynamics of their relationship. What was once an effortless connection becomes a "fragile balancing act" as they struggle to reconcile their natural physical desires with their new-found religious convictions

title: Laraba & Balarabe
summary: Balarabe returns to his ex-girlfriend, Laraba, after six months of no contact, following a tumultuous breakup, to seek closure or perhaps repeat past behaviors
synopsis: Directed by Fatimah Binta Gimsay, Laraba & Balarabe is an intimate Nigerian drama following two ex-lovers in Lagos whose relationship is marked by cycles of manipulation and emotional avoidance. The story unfolds as Balarabe abruptly returns after a six-month disappearance, forcing Laraba to confront unresolved trauma and gaslighting while she struggles to find closure. Ultimately, the film explores the fragility of modern love and the persistent effort of young Northern Nigerians to maintain their cultural identity within a sprawling, indifferent city.

title: Lagos: Sex, Lies And Traffic
summary: An illicit affair threatens to derail a political campaign and marriage of a young man.
synopsis: A poster boy of Lagos Politics, Dejo is having an affair which threatens to derail his political campaign and his marriage. Discovering his mistress is pregnant, Dejo’s wife Tolu decides to get rid of her to avoid a scandal. Lagos:Sex,Lies and Traffic is a series of interconnected stories which weave into one final act; A murder

title: Lady Buckit & the Motley Mopsters
summary: A precocious, self absorbed little girl finds herself in wildly unfamiliar territory. There, she encounters a band of highly unusual characters who change the course of her destiny.

title: Kòseégbé
summary: Kòseégbé is a 1995 Yoruba drama film directed by Tunde Kelani based on a stage play of the same name by Akinwunmi Isola.

title: Kokomma In America
summary: Kokomma is a village girl from Akwa Ibom, who was unwittingly trafficked to America. She resists every attempt to be lead into prostitution because of her strict cultural discipline and ultimately becomes stranded.

title: King Of Thieves: Agesinkole
summary: King of thieves is an epic tale of Agesinkole, an all-powerful Bandit and his reign of terror in the prosperous Kingdom of Ajeromi. Concerned by his pillaging, the kingdom moves to destroy him, through the hunters, witches and priests, thus beginning this adventurous saga of revenge, bravery and glory.

title: Kill Fred
summary: Rose gets entangled in a dangerous love triangle. She and her lover, Vick, orchestrate a plot to murder her husband, Fred. However, as the plan begins to unfold, Rose experiences hesitation, setting off unexpected twists.

title: Karishika 2
summary: Karishika and Lucifer are back, and they've brought some friends! Back to their old ways, than then some: troubling poor Christians, spreading death and sexual disease, and kidnapping your children! Once again, temptation will make you want to kiss her lips. You better be careful, she's not what she seems! She's got blood on her fingertips. That smile on her face is just a disguize, she's a demon from Hell, her eyes can hypnotize! Karishika, she sits, at the right hand side of the Devil! Karishika, she's the queen of Demons!

title: Karishika
summary: The movie displays how Satan eats his way into the souls of the living. To recruit new followers for his kingdom of darkness he sends out Karishika, queen of demons, to the world of the living. There she misguides and seduces a number of people, who all fall prey to her because of their own shortcomings. All but the last fall for the temptation of either the fulfilment of their desperate wishes, or money, or sex. The last, a pastor, resists all temptation and is saved from hell through divine intervention in a final showdown between a Pentacoastal congregation and Karishika and her helpers.

title: Kalakiri: The Price of Freedom
summary: A pro-democracy activist who disappears ahead of a presidential nomination and is later revealed to have been detained at Kalakiri, a remote island prison

title: Judas
summary: A pair of veteran lobbyists who work for one of Nigeria's biggest firms get wind of a multi-million dollar contract and decide to go after it.

title: Japa Ever After
summary: Love blossoms from Lagos to London between Zite and Zino but will it blossom or perish in a new country?
synopsis: Japa Ever After is an international faith-based love story that explores the "Japa" phenomenon; the modern exodus of Nigerians seeking better lives abroad, through the lives of a newly married couple. After relocating to London, the pair faces immediate culture shock and intense marital strain as they adjust to a new environment without the domestic support they once had in Lagos. Their relationship deteriorates into constant conflict, leading them to the brink of separation until a visiting pastor provides practical, spiritual guidance to help them reconcile and align with their purpose

title: Iyaloja
summary: Iyaloja: The Movie (Isale-Eko) follows a charming newcomer who wins the trust of market women in old Lagos while secretly plotting to become the next respected market leader, the Iyaloja. As her secrets begin to surface, jealousy, suspicion, and old rivalries force the market to decide who is truly worthy to lead.
synopsis:
Set in the old heart of Lagos, Iyaloja: The Movie (Isale-Eko) explores power, trust, rivalry, and tradition within a close-knit market community. The title Iyaloja refers to the revered female leader of the market, a position treated with deep respect by the women who depend on her wisdom and authority.

When a graceful and persuasive woman arrives in Isale-Eko, she quickly wins people over with her warmth, charm, and carefully chosen words. Before long, she begins to gain influence among the market women and quietly sets her sights on becoming the next Iyaloja. At first, many believe she is exactly what the market needs.

But her rise unsettles others. As questions begin to surface, the women discover that the newcomer may not be who she claims to be. Hidden secrets, jealousy, and old rivalries turn the succession into a bitter struggle. With the market divided and trust wearing thin, the women of Isale-Eko must look beyond charm and ambition to decide who is truly worthy of the sacred title of Iyaloja.

title: ÌWÉ ÀLÀ
summary: Iwe Àlá is a powerful Nigerian drama about a prominent tailoring family torn apart by betrayal and hidden secrets. Set during the grand Ojude Oba festival, the film beautifully connects deep Yoruba traditions with the emotional struggle to save a family legacy.
synopsis: Íwe Àlá (The Book of Dreams) is a poignant Nigerian family drama centering on a prominent tailoring dynasty threatened by intense internal conflicts and hidden betrayals. The narrative explores the complex threads of family, love, and the heavy burden of preserving a generational legacy. Set against the vibrant, grand backdrop of the historic Ojude Oba festival, the film beautifully anchors its emotional stakes within the rich heritage of the Ijebu people. This fast-paced comedy-drama showcases how families can find unity, laughter, and collective strength even when torn apart by pride and secrets.

title: Iwájú: A Day Ahead
summary: Filmed across three continents, this documentary shares the story of the founders of the Pan-African comic book company, Kugali, who made their dream a reality creating an original animation series with Walt Disney Animation Studios.

title: Invitation to Kill
summary: When a devoted father loses everything he built, he must confront how far he'll go to protect what's left.
synopsis: A man struggling with love, betrayal and the weight of fatherhood is pushed to the edge when a devastating loss changes everything he knows. As grief gives way to anger, he must confront the choices that could either consume him or lead him towards redemption.

title: Ikogosi
summary: Things aren't as they seem between a bunch of couples on a retreat at Ikogosi. Secrets they kept from each other began to unfold, as they learn the truth about each other.

title: IJELE
summary: Ijele must brave the evil forest to find a cure for his dying love

title: House On The Hill
summary: A young writer moves into a house that is to be haunted, despite the numerous warnings from the villagers, however strange encounters force him to investigate the truth behind the myths; which takes him on a journey of self-discovery and healing.

title: Food for the Soul
summary: A first-generation Nigerian American and her Black American partner must decide between being true to themselves or trying to live up to their families’ expectations.

title: Five Fifty Five
summary: The hardest part for Oma and Dayo is not realizing they are in toxic relationshipts. With the help of Dr. Pat they are able to let go of their toxic past.

title: Fire in the Word
summary: A man's wounded leg is healed by the power of Jesus; but this upsets his traditional African father.

title: Farming
summary: Based on the writer/director's childhood, FARMING tells the story of a young Nigerian boy, 'farmed out' by his parents to a white British family in the hope of a better future. Instead, he becomes the feared leader of a white skinhead gang.

title: Emotional Romance
summary: The ups and downs of a modern relationship.

title: Ejan’la
summary: Sharon, a mother of three, with an insatiable love for money, abandons her family when her husband, Williams, faces financial ruin and bankruptcy.
synopsis: When Sharon, a mother of three, leaves her husband, Williams, after he loses his job, their once-happy home crumbles. In a tragic twist of fate, Williams accidentally kills their daughter, Sandra. The two remaining sons, Austin and Jacob, are sent to live with their uncles and are taught the ways of rural life. Years later, grown and successful, Austin—haunted by past trauma—gets entangled with Angel, a married woman forced into prostitution. Their reunion in Epe leads to a confrontation with the truth that will shake their fragile family bonds.

title: Egúngún (Masquerade)
summary: In search of healing, a young woman returns home, to Nigeria, the country of her birth.

title: Don't Get Mad Get Even
summary: This is a story about 2 brothers, Jaiye and Juwon Kuti. Their relationship becomes estranged when the younger brother Juwon dropped out of school to pursue a music career. The story revolves around their conflicting lifestyles and the challenges between being highly educated but poor and less educated but very rich.

title: Don't Cry For Me
summary: A woman believed she was in the perfect marriage, but all that changed when finds a note from her husband. Tackling the dramatic changes in her life, the woman found comfort in a wealthy but blind young man.

title: Diamond Ring
summary: A certain wealthy man’s son Chidi who is down with an unknown sickness. His parents spend millions of naira and take him to various best local and international hospitals for cure but the sickness doesn’t go. His sickness puts his family in sorrow and the family’s business into an automatic halt. But Chidi’s case is beyond ordinary, he is haunted by a ghost for robbing her and she is ready to kill him.

title: DEAD
summary: A man's confession of killing a woman in self-defense unravels as detectives uncover unsettling truths about his past.

title: Chain Reaction
summary: Chain Reaction follows a family torn apart by disputes over ancestral land, inheritance and control. As Eucharia’s influence over her husband grows, tensions with Victoria and other relatives intensify. Greed, manipulation and desperation gradually push the household toward conflict, forcing each family member to face the consequences of their choices.
synopsis:
In Chain Reaction, a family is divided by conflict over ancestral land, inheritance and loyalty. At the centre is Eucharia, whose actions deepen tensions between her husband Ugochukwu and his relatives.
As resentment and manipulation spread, the family must confront the cost of greed and ambition before their bonds are destroyed.

title: Blood & Oil
summary: A small village in Nigeria without drinkable water, sustainable farming and fishing has one resource: oil. This story is based on true events; the violent havoc that ensued between the militants and government due to the oil corporations' greed, which had a ripple effect throughout the global oil industry.

title: Blood Money 2
summary: Michael struggles to vanquish the ghost of his mother and meet his corpse quota in the Vulture money cult.

title: Beast Of Two Worlds (Ajakaju)
summary: Where two worlds collide, a fearless King must do whatever is necessary to ensure the Dynasty lives on forever!

title: Banished Scroll
summary: A grieving professor inadvertently unleashes an ancient, terrifying curse after using a forbidden, mystical scroll in a desperate bid to resurrect his deceased wife.

title: Baby Shower
summary: When a happily married pregnant woman and her husband throw a baby shower it doubles as a family reunion, and shocking revelations are exposed from those whom it is least expected.

title: A Quiet Monday
summary: When the leader of a secessionist group in south-eastern Nigeria is jailed, his loyalists mandate a compulsory "sit-at-home' on Mondays in protest. Siblings Kamnonu and Ogbonna face danger when they defy the Monday restrictions.

title: A Night in 2005
summary: What started out as a fun night at a prom after party in 2005, quickly turns into Ife’s worst nightmare. She carries a dark secret from that night into adulthood that continues to plague her everyday life.

title: A Mama Deola Wedding Story
summary: To fund her son's dream wedding, a fierce matriarch battles snobbish in-laws and overwhelming chaos, only for a long-buried hospital secret to resurface and threaten both families

title: All Is Fair In Love
summary: Demi and Kanla are living the dream. Their fashion business is booming, and their friendship bond is unbreakable. However, things take a different turn when they both fall in love with Mbali, a beautiful woman who enters their lives like a whirlwind. Initially unaware of their feelings, Mbali becomes the object of their affection, setting the stage for an intense love triangle.

title: All I Know
summary: When Dapo goes missing after a hook-up, Ebube questions if keeping silent will protect his friend or put him in further danger.

title: Alakada: Bad and Bouje
summary: A woman whose flashy and glamorous reputation is based entirely on lies hits trouble when her web of deceit starts falling apart.
synopsis: The story follows Yetunde, a self-proclaimed social media influencer who creates a glamorous online persona with the help of her friends, Rebecca and Abebi. Driven by a relentless desire for fame, validation, and acceptance in elite circles, Yetunde pursues popularity despite her humble background. As the narrative progresses, she is compelled to confront her insecurities and learns the value of staying true to herself.

title: Aki Na Ukwa 2
summary: Aki and Popo's antics get them banished from their father's house. They go to live with their uncle and begin terrorizing another village.

title: A Japa Tale
summary: Emuche and Dubem, a young couple with conflicting life goals, try to save their relationship.

title: Agesinkole 2: King of Thieves
summary: When corruption quietly returns to the once-purified kingdom of Ajeromi, a forbidden love and a desperate act awaken ancient forces, threatening to shatter the fragile peace forged by the vanished myth of Agesinkole.
synopsis:
Long ago, Agesinkole descended upon the kingdom of Ajeromi like a storm sent by the gods themselves. In a time when injustice walked boldly in daylight, and corruption ruled from throne to marketplace, he stood as the shadow that restored balance. His presence struck terror into the wicked and breathed hope into the weary. And when the kingdom was finally purged-when the last echoes of chaos faded, Agesinkole vanished, leaving behind a legacy carved in fear, reverence, and unbreakable myth.
In the years that followed, life found its rhythm again. Mothers told their children stories of the masked terror who defended the helpless. Elders invoked his name to settle disputes. Kings quoted his deeds to remind themselves of mortality. What was once dread became devotion. His legend became a compass, guiding the kingdom toward a fragile but cherished peace.
But peace is a living thing... and living things can die.
As seasons changed and generations shifted, the memory of Agesinkole became comfortable, too comfortable. Under a new reign, the whispers of greed returned, first as murmurs behind palace doors, then as bold acts in broad daylight. Betrayal slithered its way into the hearts of once-loyal guardsmen. Market leaders began to cheat their people. Chiefs who once swore allegiance to Agesinkole twisted justice to suit their desires. Slowly, like a sickness ignored for too long, corruption found its way back into Ajeromi.
And when corruption finds a home, chaos is never far behind.
Amid this unraveling, a forbidden love dared to challenge ancient laws. A single choice, born from passion and truth, collided violently with the kingdom's rigid traditions. That conflict set off a chain reaction, shaking thrones, exposing secrets, and tearing open wounds the kingdom thought had long healed.
But the final blow came from an act wrapped in desperation... an act that tampered with forces no mortal should ever awaken.

title: Aberration
summary: Complications arise in the life of a couple, after they hire a call girl to be their surrogate

title: 5 Reasons Why
summary: A young photographer has to make a decision, when she finds herself entangled in two relationships - one with a father and the other, his estranged son
When the digital revolution hits Nigeria, one brilliant young mind must decide how far he will go to get out of poverty.
synopsis: The film is a gripping, nuanced exploration into the early days of Nigeria's internet revolution. It traces the origins of the infamous "419" cybercrime culture through the lens of a brilliant young man named Ndubuisi Madueke. Caught between ambition and survival, his journey highlights the human, familial, and societal costs of chasing easy money.
